payload.description_html:
Fossil bone from Bountyphaps obsoleta, an extinct Columbiforme. Discovered on Pircairn Island. Held in the collections of the Museum of New Zealand.

Images retrieved from: https://collections.tepapa.govt.nz/object/1015409

Credit Statement: Bountyphaps obsoleta, collected January 1991, Henderson Island, Pitcairn Group. Site 5., Pitcairn. CC BY 4.0. Te Papa (S.044253)
